market_context: Markets opened with massive gains following Anthropic's blockbuster debut, but aggressively reversed into afternoon losses as investors aggressively took profits and sold the AI hype. With the S&P 500 failing its morning attempt to reclaim its 200-day moving average and Treasury yields holding firm above 5.05%, intraday momentum is heavily skewed toward session lows. The surge in the VIX above 26 indicates persistent late-session de-risking into the 4:00 PM close.

predictions.reasoning: SPY failed a sharp morning rally to $739.90 that briefly reclaimed its 200-day moving average, creating a severe intraday rejection pattern. As profit-taking deepens across mega-cap tech and the VIX spikes past 26.70, institutional liquidation is likely to test and press through the intraday low of $717.55 into the close. The persistence of 10-year yields at 5.05% leaves dip buyers sidelined in the final trading hours.

Tech benchmark QQQ has completely unwound its 2%+ morning advance and is hovering just above the intraday low of $647.17. The 'sell the news' reaction to Anthropic's public debut has triggered heavy unwinds across semiconductor and AI names. Without buying support materializing at the $650 level, late-session options delta hedging will likely pressure QQQ down toward key support at $646.

AMZN is trading directly on its session lows at $259.12 after giving up an intraday high of $274.00, down over 3% on the day. As one of Anthropic's largest corporate backers, the pullback in Anthropic shares from their opening print has catalyzed aggressive profit-taking across Amazon. Weak closing-cross positioning and technical deterioration suggest an extension toward the $257 level before 4:00 PM.

META is struggling to defend the critical psychological support level at $600 after falling from a high of $630.01 earlier in the session. Broad-based tech derisking and surging volatility are discouraging late afternoon dip buying across high-multiple AI software and platforms. A clean technical breakdown below $600 should trigger trailing sell stops toward $596 into the close.
